svg.aria-label: The pieces, and what each is for
svg.title: The pieces, and what each is for
svg.text: The pieces, and what each is for
Not a stack to memorize — the few parts you’ll meet, and the job each one does for you.
Sovereign
the assistant you talk to.
CLI · desktop · server — the
whole loop, on your machine.
it composes two things:
a local model
runs on your hardware — answers you, no cloud
corpus-engine
turns your sources — notes, email, Wikipedia —
into knowledge it can search and cite
cmnwlth
optional
pool machines with people you trust — a research group, a clinic,
a co-op. Run a model bigger than any one of you could,
or share knowledge that never leaves its owner’s disk.
federates both, by invitation
It speaks the ordinary OpenAI API, so any OpenAI-compatible tool just works — OICP only adds a thin layer on top,
so nodes can advertise what they’re good at. No server in the middle, no account. The real foundation is the one
thing the others rest on: you can read the source and check every claim yourself.
